title: After the Japanese Oaks: The Outline of Magic

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Following a heated race, the competing Umamusume come to agree with Sweep Tosho—winning the Triple Tiara is a great achievement in itself.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Zenno Rob Roy even says that watching today's race has given her courage, and that it was "like seeing magic at work."

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Pleased that someone fell under her spell, Sweep Tosho begins preparations for her next race—the Shuka Sho.
